name: DriftAgent-AFM-based
description: An AI-powered agent that automatically detects drift between your API implementation and OpenAPI specification on every pull request, posting a review comment with any mismatches found.

name: CodePulse
description: A VS Code extension that detects performance issues in your code using AI — powered by Groq's LLM API. Issues appear as inline diagnostics in the editor and Problems panel, just like ESLint.
